source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3 (PDF 212), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Kisi bhi karobar ki kamyabi ke liye apni market (bazaar) ko samajhna bohat zaroori hai. Market insights jama karne ka matlab hai apne target customers, competitors (muqabil karobar) aur poore bazaar ke mahol ke bare mein maloomat jama karna aur us ka analysis (tajziya) karna. Yeh maloomat business strategy, products aur marketing ke bare mein soch samajh kar faisle karne mein madad deti hai. Aage hum market research ke mukhtalif tareeqe dekhenge aur yeh ke in se market ko gehrai se kaise samjha ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Market insights jama karne ka maqsad kya hai (MCQ 5)? Naye karobar ke liye market research kyun zaroori hai (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 5: (b) customers ki zarooratein aur market ke trends samajhna. Naye karobar ka koi purana record nahi hota, is liye research batati hai ke log product chahte hain ya nahi, kitne paise denge, competitors kaun hain aur un se mukhtalif kaise nazar aayein. Is se nakami ka risk kam hota hai.

items: Market insights: faisle se pehle customers, competitors aur bazaar ko jaanein.
